title: Reworked Jump
description: A plugin that completely reworks the Jump Boost potion effect. Jump Boost now grants extra mid-air jumps, directional air dashes, and vertical launch jumps.
body:
# Features

* Jump Boost I = 1 extra jump
* Jump Boost II = 2 extra jumps
* Configurable maximum jump limit
* Mid-air directional dash
* Sneak + jump for a vertical launch
* Action bar jump indicator
* Fully configurable

---

# How It Works

## Normal Air Jump

When you have Jump Boost:

1. Jump normally from the ground
2. While in the air, press space again
3. You perform an extra jump

The amount of extra jumps depends on your Jump Boost level.

---

## Dash Jump

If you are NOT sneaking:

* Pressing space mid-air launches you forward
* Looking upward increases vertical momentum
* The dash gives both horizontal and vertical movement

---

## Vertical Launch Jump

If you ARE sneaking:

* Pressing space mid-air launches you straight upward
* Stronger vertical boost
* Reduced horizontal momentum

---

# Action Bar Indicator

When you are eligible to use an extra jump:

* A green `/\` appears briefly in the action bar
* Only shows once per airtime
* Resets after touching the ground

---

# Config

```yml
enabled: true

max-extra-jumps: 5

jump-velocity: 0.65
sneak-jump-velocity: 1.3

dash-strength: 0.9
dash-vertical-boost: 0.38

jump-cooldown-ms: 250
ground-cooldown-ms: 350
```
